info.name: Banfigo API
info.description: Mini Banking / Open Banking Consent Management API. Pick the "Banfigo – Local" or "Banfigo – Docker" environment, then run the folders in order (or Run collection). Tokens for admin1 / maker1 / checker1 / customer1 are fetched automatically. See postman/README.md for step-by-step instructions.

item.name: 0. Auth (manual check)
item.description: Optional: shows the raw Keycloak token call. Every other request already gets its token automatically (collection pre-request script).

request.description: Password grant against Keycloak. Paste the access_token into https://jwt.io to see `realm_access.roles` and `iss`.

item.name: 2. Customers (ADMIN)
item.description: Create / read / update need a token; create, update and delete need the ADMIN role.

item.name: 3. Accounts (ADMIN creates)
item.description: Opening an account needs ADMIN; reading needs any valid token. New accounts start at balance 0.

item.name: 4. Transactions (MAKER)
item.description: Deposits and withdrawals need MAKER. History supports page/size and from/to/type filters.

item.name: 5. Beneficiaries
item.description: Adding needs any valid token; deleting needs ADMIN or CHECKER (see folder 10).

item.name: 6. Transfers (MAKER)
item.description: Transfers between accounts and to beneficiaries, the per-transaction limit, and the Idempotency-Key header that makes retries safe.

request.description: banfigo.limits.max-transaction-amount (default 100000) caps every deposit, withdrawal and transfer.
Send a unique Idempotency-Key with each transfer and reuse it when retrying.

item.name: Repeat same key (same transfer, no new debit)

request.description: Simulates a retry: the API returns the first result instead of moving the money again.

exec: pm.test("Same reference as the first request", () => pm.expect(body.reference).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("idempotentReference")));
pm.test("Same balance as after the first request", () => pm.expect(String(body.fromAccountBalance)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("idempotentBalance")));

item.name: Balance of A moved only once

exec: pm.test("Balance equals the balance after the first transfer", () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.json().balance)).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("idempotentBalance"))));

item.name: 11. Customer self-service (customer1)
item.description: A self-registered CUSTOMER only sees and moves their own money. Needs the customer1 user from keycloak/realm-export.json (re-import the realm if your Keycloak predates it).

request.description: The first call by a new customer login creates their Customer record (name and email from the token).
/api/me is only for CUSTOMER logins.
